items.escalations: Bank and client escalations with severity, owner and deadline, tracked to closure.
items.offroll-agents: Vendor / off-roll field agents by company and branch with payout basis, DRA and PCC status — outside payroll.
items.agent-auth: The bank's authorisation letter / ID per employee, bank and portfolio with validity; expiring within the configured window first.
items.dra-certs: Each employee's DRA certificate status and expiry from the employee record: due within the window, expired, valid — with a link to record the renewal.
items.complaints: Borrower complaints against agents with source, channel, severity and status to closure.
items.reports: Aggregate reports declared in config/reports.json: counts and totals by department, branch, status and more, each behind the permission of the table it reads.
items.report-headcount: Live headcount by company, branch or department, scoped by Organization Setup, with a CSV.
items.report-attendance-summary: Per employee for a month: days by attendance status and exact hours.
items.report-leave-summary: Per employee for a month: approved leave days by type, exact to the fraction.
items.report-salary-register: Per employee: gross, deductions and net from the closed run of the month, summed from the run's own lines in paise.
items.report-pf-esi-summary: Who is inside PF and ESI with UAN and ESI numbers, and how many.
items.report-birthdays: Whose birthday falls in the month, by day, with the age they turn.
items.activity-logs: The hash-chained audit trail: who changed what, when, and whether the chain still verifies.
items.report-datasets: Preview any dataset (employees, payslips, leave, punches, regularisations, loans, advances) with the same filters and period as every summary, and export it to Excel or CSV.
